description: The running savings record, as estimates compared with typical prices nearby: the headline `vsTypical` (paid vs the typical, median price of the same items around the store on the same days; positive = under typical), `vsCheapest` (left on the table) and `vsPriciest`, totals by flyer week and by month, the best and worst lines, every line with the prices behind it, `summary` (lead with this: what was compared, what wasn't and why), `shareable`, one sentence the user can post, and `method` with `methodUrl`, a short plain explanation of how savings are counted and where it's published, to give the user when they ask. Totals count ranged lines only; thin and unranged lines are counted separately. Free, including after the trial.
name: get_savings
title: The user's savings record
